ko.title: [국제 물류 #3] 바다 위의 버스와 택시: 해운 시장은 실제로 어떻게 작동하는가

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > 해상 운송은 정기적인 "라이너(liner)" 서비스와 수요에 따라 움직이는 "트램프(tramp)" 서비스라는 두 시장으로 나뉩니다. 선사 동맹은 선박을 공유하며, 운임 지수는 화물 운송 비용을 추적합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: 전 세계 교역량의 약 80%가 해상으로 운송되지만, "해운"은 하나의 시장이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: 실제로는 두 개의 시장이며, 서로 다른 규칙에 따라 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: 라이너 해운: 바다 위의 버스.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: 라이너 선사는 공표된 일정에 따라 고정된 항로를 운항합니다.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: 선박은 만선 여부와 관계없이 매주 상하이를 출발하며, 동일한 순서로 같은 항구에 기항합니다.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: 라이너는 주로 전자제품, 의류, 가구, 자동차 부품과 같은 제조품을 담은 **컨테이너**를 운송합니다.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: 버스 승객처럼 수천 명의 화주가 각 선박을 공유합니다.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 소규모 화주는 보통 선사나 포워더(운송 주선인)가 제시하는 운임을 지불합니다.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: 대형 화주는 연간 **서비스 계약**을 협상합니다.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: 트램프 해운: 바다 위의 택시.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: 트램프 선박은 고정된 일정이 없습니다.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: 화주가 원하는 곳이면 어디든 갑니다.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: 주로 철광석, 석탄, 곡물, 원유와 같은 **벌크(bulk)** 화물을 운송하며, 종종 한 척의 배를 하나의 화물로 가득 채웁니다.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: 이 거래를 **용선(charter)**이라고 하며, 세 가지 주요 유형이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **항해 용선(Voyage charter)**: A항구에서 B항구까지 화물 하나를 운송하는 대가를 지불합니다.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **기간 용선(Time charter)**: 정해진 기간 동안 선박과 선원을 빌립니다.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **나용선(Bareboat charter)**: 선박만 빌리고 선원과 운영은 직접 해결합니다.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **해운 동맹.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: 현대적인 컨테이너선은 20,000개 이상의 컨테이너를 실을 수 있으며, 주간 서비스를 운영하려면 여러 척이 필요합니다.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: 그 많은 공간을 채우기 위해 선사들은 **동맹(alliances)**을 결성합니다.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: 회원사들은 선박 공유 협정을 통해 서로의 선박 공간을 공유하며, 이를 통해 개별 선사가 단독으로 운영할 수 있는 것보다 더 많은 항로와 운항 횟수를 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: 동맹은 *선박*을 공유하지만 *가격*을 함께 결정하지는 않습니다. 각 선사는 여전히 자체 운임을 설정합니다.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: 이 점이 가격을 담합했던 과거의 **해운 동맹(liner conferences)**과는 다릅니다.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: EU는 2008년에 이러한 동맹을 금지했습니다.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: 미국에서는 선사 간 협정이 연방해사위원회(FMC)에 제출되고 감독을 받습니다.

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: 2025년 기준, 주요 그룹은 **제미나이 협력(Gemini Cooperation)**(머스크 및 하파그로이드), **오션 얼라이언스(Ocean Alliance)**(CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, 에버그린), **프리미어 얼라이언스(Premier Alliance)**(ONE, HMM, 양밍)입니다.

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**는 세계 최대 컨테이너 선사로, 독자적으로 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: 동맹 구성원은 몇 년마다 바뀌므로 의존하기 전에 현재 라인업을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **운임 지수.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: 해운 가격은 변동폭이 크기 때문에 업계에서는 지수를 통해 이를 추적합니다:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **발틱 건화물 운임지수(BDI)**: 런던 발틱거래소에서 발표합니다. 건화물선(드라이 벌크) 용선 비용을 추적하며 종종 원자재 수요의 신호로 읽힙니다.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **상하이 컨테이너 운임지수(SCFI)**: 상하이발 항로의 스팟(현물) 컨테이너 운임입니다.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **드류리 세계 컨테이너 지수(WCI)** 및 **프레이토스 발틱 지수(FBX)**: 주요 동서 항로의 스팟 컨테이너 운임으로, 보통 40피트 컨테이너(FEU)당 가격으로 표시됩니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속의 해운

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: 댈러스에 있는 중견 가구 수입업체가 상하이 근처 공장에서 소파를 구매한다고 가정해 봅시다.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: 이 상품은 **라이너**를 통해 운송됩니다. 컨테이너는 매주 로스앤젤레스/롱비치 항구로 배송된 후 철도를 통해 텍사스로 이동합니다.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: 이 수입업체는 한 선사와 연간 서비스 계약을 맺고 있으며, 바쁜 달에는 스팟 시장에서 추가 공간을 예약하기 위해 포워더를 이용합니다.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: 2021년, 팬데믹 기간 동안 수요가 급증하면서 항구가 정체되었습니다.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: FBX와 같은 지수로 측정된 중국발 미국 서부 해안행 스팟 운임은 **40피트 컨테이너당 $20,000**를 넘어섰습니다.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: 팬데믹 이전에는 보통 $2,000 미만이었습니다.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: 스팟 시장에 의존하던 수입업체들은 해운 비용이 급등하는 것을 목격했고, 이는 소매 가격 인상으로 이어졌습니다.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: 계약을 맺은 수입업체들은 더 잘 보호받았지만, 일부 선사가 계약된 슬롯을 모두 이행하는 데 어려움을 겪었기 때문에 항상 그런 것은 아니었습니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: 한편, 뉴올리언스에서 아시아로 대두를 수출하는 곡물 수출업체는 **트램프** 시장을 이용합니다.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: 이 업체는 벌크선 전체를 용선하며, 컨테이너 지수가 아닌 **발틱 건화물 운임지수(BDI)**를 주시합니다.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: 같은 바다, 다른 시장입니다.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3줄 요약

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **라이너** 해운은 컨테이너 화물을 위해 고정된 정기 항로를 운항합니다(버스). **트램프** 해운은 벌크 화물을 위해 수요에 따라 용선합니다(택시).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **동맹**은 컨테이너 선사들이 선박 공간을 공유하여 더 넓은 네트워크를 제공하게 해주지만, 과거의 담합과는 달리 가격을 고정하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. BDI(벌크)와 SCFI, WCI, FBX(컨테이너) 같은 **운임 지수**는 제품 가격에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 변동성 큰 해운 비용을 추적합니다.

segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.tr: **Q1.** 제철소가 철광석을 필요한 곳으로 옮기기 위해 12개월 동안 벌크선과 선원을 빌렸습니다.

segments.tr: 이것은 어떤 계약 방식인가요?

segments.tr: **Q3.** 석탄과 곡물을 운송하는 선박의 용선 비용을 추적하려면 어떤 지수를 봐야 할까요?

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **라이너 해운(Liner shipping)**: 고정 항로를 운항하는 정기 해상 서비스로, 주로 컨테이너를 운송하며 많은 화주에게 열려 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **트램프 해운(Tramp shipping)**: 정해진 일정이 없는 해상 서비스로, 화물(주로 벌크)을 필요한 곳으로 운송하기 위해 선박을 용선합니다.

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **용선 계약(Charter party)**: 선박을 빌리는 계약(항해, 기간, 또는 나용선).

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **해운 동맹(Shipping alliance)**: 가격 담합 없이 선박 공간을 공유하고 서비스를 조정하는 컨테이너 선사 그룹.

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: 표준 40피트 컨테이너로, 컨테이너 운임을 산정하는 일반적인 단위.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – C.
segments.tr: *정답: Q1 – C.

segments.src: Renting a ship with its crew for a set period is a time charter.
segments.tr: 정해진 기간 동안 선원과 함께 선박을 빌리는 것은 기간 용선입니다.

segments.src: A voyage charter covers a single trip, and a bareboat charter excludes the crew.
segments.tr: 항해 용선은 단일 항해를 다루며, 나용선은 선원을 제외합니다.

segments.src: Q2 – False.
segments.tr: Q2 – 거짓.

segments.src: Alliances share vessel space and schedules, but each carrier sets its own prices.
segments.tr: 동맹은 선박 공간과 일정을 공유하지만, 각 선사는 자체 운임을 설정합니다.

segments.src: Joint price-fixing was the feature of the old liner conferences.
segments.tr: 공동 가격 결정은 과거 해운 동맹(liner conferences)의 특징이었습니다.

segments.src: Q3 – B.
segments.tr: Q3 – B.

segments.src: The Baltic Dry Index tracks dry bulk charter costs.
segments.tr: 발틱 건화물 운임지수는 건화물 용선 비용을 추적합니다.

segments.src: The other three track container rates.*
segments.tr: 나머지 세 가지는 컨테이너 운임을 추적합니다.*

zh.title: [国际物流 #3] 海洋上的公交车与出租车：航运市场是如何运作的

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > 海洋航运分为两个市场：定期“班轮”服务和按需“不定期船”服务。承运人联盟共享船舶，运价指数追踪货物运输成本。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: 按体积计算，约 80% 的世界贸易通过海运完成，但“航运”并非单一市场。

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: 它实际上是两个市场，且遵循不同的规则。

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: 班轮航运：海洋上的公交车。**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: 班轮承运人按照公布的时间表运行固定航线。

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: 无论是否装满，船舶每周都会从上海出发，并按相同顺序停靠相同的港口。

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: 班轮主要运输电子产品、服装、家具和汽车零部件等制成品的**集装箱**。

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: 成千上万的托运人共享每一艘船，就像公交车上的乘客一样。

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 小型托运人通常支付由承运人或货运代理报价的运费。

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: 大型托运人则协商年度**服务合同**。

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: 不定期船航运：海洋上的出租车。**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: 不定期船没有固定时间表。

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: 它们根据货主的需求前往任何地方。

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: 它们主要运输铁矿石、煤炭、谷物和原油等**散装**大宗商品，通常用整艘船装载单一货物。

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: 这种交易被称为**租船**，主要有三种类型：

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **航次租船**：支付费用将一批货物从 A 港运至 B 港。

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **定期租船**：在特定期限内租用船舶及其船员。

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **光船租船**：仅租用船舶，并自行提供船员和运营。

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **航运联盟。**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: 现代集装箱船可装载超过 20,000 个集装箱，维持每周的服务需要多艘船舶。

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: 为了填满这些空间，承运人组成了**联盟**。

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: 成员通过船舶共享协议在彼此的船上共享舱位，这使他们能够提供比任何单一承运人单独运营更多的航线和班次。

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: 联盟共享*船舶*，但他们不共同设定*价格*；每个承运人仍然设定自己的费率。

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: 这使他们区别于旧式的**班轮公会**，后者确实会固定价格。

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: 欧盟在 2008 年取缔了班轮公会。

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: 在美国，承运人协议需向联邦海事委员会 (FMC) 备案并受其监管。

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: 截至 2025 年，主要集团包括**双子星协作组织 (Gemini Cooperation)**（马士基和赫伯罗特）、**海洋联盟 (Ocean Alliance)**（达飞海运、中远海运/东方海外和长荣海运）以及**Premier Alliance**（海洋网联船务、现代商船和阳明海运）。

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **地中海航运 (MSC)** 是全球最大的集装箱航运公司，独立运营。

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: 联盟成员每几年就会发生变化，因此在依赖它们之前请查看当前的阵容。

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **运价指数。**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: 航运价格波动剧烈，因此行业通过指数进行追踪：

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **波罗的海干散货指数 (BDI)**：由伦敦波罗的海交易所发布。它追踪干散货船的租船成本，常被解读为原材料需求的信号。

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **上海出口集装箱运价指数 (SCFI)**：从上海出发航线的集装箱现货运价。

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **德鲁里世界集装箱运价指数 (WCI)** 和 **Freightos 波罗的海指数 (FBX)**：主要东西向航线的集装箱现货运价，通常以 40 英尺集装箱 (FEU) 为单位报价。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的应用

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: 想象一下达拉斯的一家中型家具进口商，从上海附近的工厂购买沙发。

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: 其货物通过**班轮**运输：集装箱每周运往洛杉矶/长滩港，然后通过铁路运往德克萨斯州。

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: 该进口商与一家承运人签订了年度服务合同，并在繁忙月份通过货运代理在现货市场上预订额外舱位。

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: 2021 年，疫情期间需求激增，港口出现拥堵。

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: 以 FBX 等指数衡量的从中国到美国西海岸的现货运价攀升至每 40 英尺集装箱 **$20,000 以上**。

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: 疫情前，这些运价通常低于 $2,000。

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: 依赖现货市场的进口商面临航运成本飙升，这推高了零售价格。

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: 有合同的进口商受到的保护较好，但并非总是如此，因为一些承运人难以履行所有合同约定的舱位。

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: 与此同时，新奥尔良的一家向亚洲出口大豆的谷物出口商使用**不定期船**市场。

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: 它租用整艘散货船，并关注**波罗的海干散货指数**，而不是集装箱指数。

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: 同一片海洋，不同的市场。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3 行总结

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **班轮**航运为集装箱货物提供固定的定期航线（公交车）。**不定期船**航运则是按需租船运输散装货物（出租车）。

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **联盟**允许集装箱承运人共享船舶舱位以提供更广泛的网络，但与旧式的班轮公会不同，他们不固定价格。

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. **运价指数**如 BDI（散货）以及 SCFI、WCI 和 FBX（集装箱）追踪波动的航运成本，这些成本直接影响产品价格。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测

segments.tr: **Q1.** 一家钢铁厂租用了一艘散货船及其船员 12 个月，以便将铁矿石运往任何需要的地方。

segments.tr: **Q3.** 你会关注哪个指数来追踪运输煤炭和谷物的船舶的租船成本？

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **班轮航运 (Liner shipping)**：在固定航线上提供定期海洋服务，主要用于集装箱，面向众多托运人开放。

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **不定期船航运 (Tramp shipping)**：非定期的海洋服务，通过租船运输货物（通常是散装货物），按需前往任何地方。

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **租船合同 (Charter party)**：雇佣船舶的合同（航次租船、定期租船或光船租船）。

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **航运联盟 (Shipping alliance)**：一组共享船舶舱位并协调服务但不固定价格的集装箱承运人。

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**：标准 40 英尺集装箱，是报价集装箱运费的常用单位。

hi.title: [अंतर्राष्ट्रीय लॉजिस्टिक्स #3] समुद्र पर बस बनाम टैक्सी: शिपिंग बाज़ार वास्तव में कैसे काम करता है

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > समुद्री शिपिंग दो बाज़ारों में विभाजित है, निर्धारित "लाइनर" सेवा और मांग पर आधारित "ट्रैम्प" सेवा। कैरियर गठबंधन जहाजों को साझा करते हैं, और फ्रेट इंडेक्स माल ढुलाई की लागत को ट्रैक करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: दुनिया के लगभग 80% व्यापार की मात्रा समुद्र के रास्ते होती है, लेकिन "शिपिंग" एक बाज़ार नहीं है।

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: यह वास्तव में दो हैं, और वे अलग-अलग नियमों पर चलते हैं।

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: लाइनर शिपिंग: समुद्री बस।**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: लाइनर कैरियर प्रकाशित समय-सारणी पर निश्चित मार्गों पर चलते हैं।

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: एक जहाज हर हफ्ते शंघाई से निकलता है, चाहे वह भरा हो या नहीं, और यह उसी क्रम में उन्हीं बंदरगाहों पर रुकता है।

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: लाइनर मुख्य रूप से इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, कपड़े, फर्नीचर और ऑटो पार्ट्स जैसे निर्मित सामानों के **कंटेनर** ले जाते हैं।

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: हजारों शिपर प्रत्येक जहाज को साझा करते हैं, जैसे बस में यात्री।

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: छोटे शिपर आमतौर पर कैरियर या फ्रेट फॉरवर्डर द्वारा उद्धृत दरों का भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: बड़े शिपर वार्षिक **सेवा अनुबंधों** पर बातचीत करते हैं।

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: ट्रैम्प शिपिंग: समुद्री टैक्सी।**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: ट्रैम्प जहाजों की कोई निश्चित समय-सारणी नहीं होती है।

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: वे वहां जाते हैं जहां कार्गो मालिक को उनकी आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: वे मुख्य रूप से **बल्क** कमोडिटी जैसे लौह अयस्क, कोयला, अनाज और कच्चे तेल को ले जाते हैं, अक्सर पूरे जहाज को एक ही कार्गो से भर देते हैं।

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: इस सौदे को **चार्टर** कहा जाता है, और इसके तीन मुख्य प्रकार हैं:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **वॉयज चार्टर**: आप एक कार्गो को बंदरगाह A से बंदरगाह B तक ले जाने के लिए भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **टाइम चार्टर**: आप एक निश्चित अवधि के लिए जहाज और उसके चालक दल को किराए पर लेते हैं।

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **बेयरबोट चार्टर**: आप केवल जहाज किराए पर लेते हैं और अपना खुद का चालक दल और संचालन प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **शिपिंग गठबंधन।**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: एक आधुनिक कंटेनर जहाज 20,000 से अधिक कंटेनर ले जा सकता है, और साप्ताहिक सेवा चलाने के लिए उनमें से कई की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: इतनी जगह भरने के लिए, कैरियर **गठबंधन** बनाते हैं।

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: सदस्य वेसल-शेयरिंग समझौतों के माध्यम से एक-दूसरे के जहाजों पर जगह साझा करते हैं, जो उन्हें किसी एक के अकेले चलाने की तुलना में अधिक मार्ग और यात्राएं प्रदान करने की अनुमति देता है।

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: गठबंधन *जहाजों* को साझा करते हैं, लेकिन वे एक साथ *कीमतें* निर्धारित नहीं करते हैं; प्रत्येक कैरियर अभी भी अपनी दरें खुद तय करता है।

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: यह उन्हें पुराने **लाइनर सम्मेलनों** से अलग बनाता है, जो कीमतें तय करते थे।

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: यूरोपीय संघ ने 2008 में सम्मेलनों पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया था।

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: अमेरिका में, कैरियर समझौतों को फेडरल मैरीटाइम कमीशन (FMC) के पास दायर किया जाता है और उनकी देखरेख की जाती है।

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: 2025 तक, मुख्य समूह **जेमिनी कोऑपरेशन** (मर्स्क और हैपाग-लॉयड), **ओशन एलायंस** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, और एवरग्रीन), और **प्रीमियर एलायंस** (ONE, HMM, और यांग मिंग) थे।

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**, दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी कंटेनर लाइन, अपने दम पर काम करती है।

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: गठबंधन की सदस्यता हर कुछ वर्षों में बदलती रहती है, इसलिए उन पर भरोसा करने से पहले वर्तमान लाइनअप की जांच करें।

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **फ्रेट इंडेक्स।**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: शिपिंग की कीमतें व्यापक रूप से बदलती हैं, इसलिए उद्योग उन्हें इंडेक्स के साथ ट्रैक करता है:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **बाल्टिक ड्राई इंडेक्स (BDI)**: लंदन के बाल्टिक एक्सचेंज द्वारा प्रकाशित। यह ड्राई बल्क जहाजों को चार्टर करने की लागत को ट्रैक करता है और इसे अक्सर कच्चे माल की मांग के संकेत के रूप में पढ़ा जाता है।

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **शंघाई कंटेनराइज्ड फ्रेट इंडेक्स (SCFI)**: शंघाई से बाहर के मार्गों के लिए स्पॉट कंटेनर दरें।

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **ड्र्यूरी वर्ल्ड कंटेनर इंडेक्स (WCI)** और **फ्रेटोस बाल्टिक इंडेक्स (FBX)**: प्रमुख पूर्व-पश्चिम मार्गों पर स्पॉट कंटेनर दरें, आमतौर पर प्रति 40-फुट कंटेनर (FEU) उद्धृत की जाती हैं।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## दैनिक जीवन में

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: डलास में एक मध्यम आकार के फर्नीचर आयातक की कल्पना करें जो शंघाई के पास एक कारखाने से सोफे खरीदता है।

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: इसका सामान **लाइनर** द्वारा यात्रा करता है: कंटेनर साप्ताहिक रूप से पोर्ट ऑफ लॉस एंजिल्स/लॉन्ग बीच तक जाते हैं, फिर रेल द्वारा टेक्सास जाते हैं।

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: आयातक का एक कैरियर के साथ वार्षिक सेवा अनुबंध है, साथ ही व्यस्त महीनों के दौरान स्पॉट मार्केट पर अतिरिक्त जगह बुक करने के लिए एक फॉरवर्डर भी है।

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: 2021 में, महामारी के दौरान मांग बढ़ गई और बंदरगाहों पर भीड़ हो गई।

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: FBX जैसे इंडेक्स द्वारा मापी गई चीन से अमेरिकी वेस्ट कोस्ट तक की स्पॉट दरें, **$20,000 प्रति 40-फुट कंटेनर** से ऊपर चढ़ गईं।

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: महामारी से पहले वे आमतौर पर $2,000 से कम थीं।

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: जो आयातक स्पॉट मार्केट पर निर्भर थे, उन्होंने शिपिंग लागत में उछाल देखा, जिससे खुदरा कीमतें बढ़ गईं।

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: अनुबंध वाले आयातक बेहतर सुरक्षित थे, हालांकि हमेशा नहीं, क्योंकि कुछ कैरियर हर अनुबंधित स्लॉट का सम्मान करने के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे थे।

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: इस बीच, न्यू ऑरलियन्स में सोयाबीन को एशिया भेजने वाला एक अनाज निर्यातक **ट्रैम्प** बाज़ार का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: यह पूरे बल्क कैरियर को चार्टर करता है, और यह कंटेनर इंडेक्स के बजाय **बाल्टिक ड्राई इंडेक्स** को देखता है।

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: वही समुद्र, अलग-अलग बाज़ार।

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3-लाइन सारांश

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **लाइनर** शिपिंग कंटेनरीकृत सामानों के लिए निश्चित, निर्धारित मार्ग चलाती है (बस)। **ट्रैम्प** शिपिंग बल्क कार्गो के लिए मांग पर चार्टर की जाती है (टैक्सी)।

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **गठबंधन** कंटेनर कैरियर को व्यापक नेटवर्क प्रदान करने के लिए जहाज की जगह साझा करने देते हैं, लेकिन पुराने सम्मेलनों के विपरीत, वे कीमतें तय नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. BDI (बल्क) और SCFI, WCI, और FBX (कंटेनर) जैसे **फ्रेट इंडेक्स** अस्थिर शिपिंग लागतों को ट्रैक करते हैं जो सीधे उत्पाद की कीमतों को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.tr: ## ✅ सेल्फ-क्विज़

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज के शब्द

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **लाइनर शिपिंग**: निश्चित मार्गों पर निर्धारित समुद्री सेवा, मुख्य रूप से कंटेनरों के लिए, कई शिपर्स के लिए खुली।

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **ट्रैम्प शिपिंग**: अनिर्धारित समुद्री सेवा जिसमें जहाजों को कार्गो, आमतौर पर बल्क, को जहां भी जरूरत हो, ले जाने के लिए चार्टर किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **चार्टर पार्टी**: जहाज किराए पर लेने का अनुबंध (वॉयज, टाइम, या बेयरबोट)।

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **शिपिंग गठबंधन**: कंटेनर कैरियर का एक समूह जो जहाज की जगह साझा करता है और कीमतें तय किए बिना सेवाओं का समन्वय करता है।

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU (फोर्टी-फुट इक्विवेलेंट यूनिट)**: एक मानक 40-फुट कंटेनर, कंटेनर फ्रेट दरों को उद्धृत करने के लिए सामान्य इकाई।

segments.src: A voyage charter covers a single trip, and a bareboat charter excludes the crew.
segments.tr: वॉयज चार्टर एक एकल यात्रा को कवर करता है, और बेयरबोट चार्टर में चालक दल शामिल नहीं होता है।

es.title: [Logística Internacional #3] Autobuses frente a taxis en el océano: cómo funciona realmente el mercado naviero

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > El transporte marítimo se divide en dos mercados: el servicio "de línea" programado y el servicio "tramp" (o de libre navegación) bajo demanda. Las alianzas de transportistas comparten barcos y los índices de fletes rastrean cuánto cuesta mover mercancías.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: Alrededor del 80% del comercio mundial por volumen viaja por mar, pero el "transporte marítimo" no es un mercado único.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: En realidad son dos, y funcionan bajo reglas diferentes.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: Transporte de línea: el autobús oceánico.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: Los transportistas de línea operan rutas fijas con horarios publicados.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: Un barco sale de Shanghái cada semana, esté lleno o no, y hace escala en los mismos puertos en el mismo orden.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: Las líneas transportan principalmente **contenedores** de productos manufacturados como electrónica, ropa, muebles y autopartes.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: Miles de cargadores comparten cada buque, de forma muy parecida a los pasajeros de un autobús.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Los pequeños cargadores suelen pagar tarifas cotizadas por el transportista o un agente de carga.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: Los grandes cargadores negocian **contratos de servicio** anuales.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: Transporte tramp: el taxi oceánico.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: Los barcos tramp no tienen un horario fijo.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: Van a donde el propietario de la carga necesite que vayan.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: Transportan principalmente productos **a granel** como mineral de hierro, carbón, grano y petróleo crudo, a menudo llenando todo el barco con una sola carga.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: El acuerdo se llama **fletamento** (charter), y hay tres tipos principales:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **Fletamento por viaje (Voyage charter)**: pagas por mover una carga del puerto A al puerto B.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **Fletamento por tiempo (Time charter)**: alquilas el barco y su tripulación por un período determinado.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **Fletamento a casco desnudo (Bareboat charter)**: alquilas solo el barco y suministras tu propia tripulación y operaciones.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **Alianzas navieras.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: Un buque portacontenedores moderno puede transportar más de 20,000 contenedores, y operar un servicio semanal requiere varios de ellos.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: Para llenar tanto espacio, los transportistas forman **alianzas**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: Los miembros comparten espacio en los barcos de los demás a través de acuerdos de uso compartido de buques, lo que les permite ofrecer más rutas y viajes de los que cualquiera de ellos podría operar por sí solo.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: Las alianzas comparten *barcos*, pero no establecen *precios* juntos; cada transportista sigue fijando sus propias tarifas.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: Eso los hace diferentes de las antiguas **conferencias marítimas**, que sí fijaban precios.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: La UE prohibió las conferencias en 2008.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: En los EE. UU., los acuerdos de los transportistas se presentan ante la Comisión Marítima Federal (FMC) y son supervisados por ella.

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: A partir de 2025, las principales agrupaciones eran la **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk y Hapag-Lloyd), la **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL y Evergreen), y la **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM y Yang Ming).

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**, la línea de contenedores más grande del mundo, opera por su cuenta.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: La membresía de las alianzas cambia cada pocos años, así que verifica las alineaciones actuales antes de confiar en ellas.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **Índices de fletes.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: Los precios del transporte marítimo fluctúan ampliamente, por lo que la industria los rastrea con índices:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: publicado por el Baltic Exchange de Londres. Rastrea el costo de fletar barcos de carga seca a granel y a menudo se interpreta como una señal de la demanda de materias primas.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: tarifas spot de contenedores para rutas que salen de Shanghái.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Imagina un importador de muebles de tamaño mediano en Dallas que compra sofás a una fábrica cerca de Shanghái.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: Sus mercancías viajan por **línea**: los contenedores se envían semanalmente al Puerto de Los Ángeles/Long Beach, luego van por ferrocarril a Texas.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: El importador tiene un contrato de servicio anual con un transportista, además de un agente de carga para reservar espacio adicional en el mercado spot durante los meses de mayor actividad.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: En 2021, la demanda aumentó durante la pandemia y los puertos se congestionaron.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: Las tarifas spot de China a la costa oeste de EE. UU., medidas por índices como el FBX, subieron por encima de los **$20,000 por contenedor de 40 pies**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Antes de la pandemia, normalmente habían estado por debajo de los $2,000.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Los importadores que dependían del mercado spot vieron dispararse los costos de envío, lo que elevó los precios minoristas.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Los importadores con contratos estaban mejor protegidos, aunque no siempre, porque algunos transportistas tuvieron dificultades para cumplir con todos los espacios contratados.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, un exportador de granos en Nueva Orleans que envía soja a Asia utiliza el mercado **tramp**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Fleta un buque de carga a granel completo y observa el **Baltic Dry Index** en lugar de los índices de contenedores.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Mismo océano, diferentes mercados.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumen de 3 líneas

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. El transporte de **línea** opera rutas fijas y programadas para mercancías en contenedores (el autobús). El transporte **tramp** se fleta bajo demanda para carga a granel (el taxi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. Las **alianzas** permiten a los transportistas de contenedores compartir espacio en los buques para ofrecer redes más amplias, pero a diferencia de las antiguas conferencias, no fijan precios.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. Los **índices de fletes** como el BDI (granel) y el SCFI, WCI y FBX (contenedores) rastrean los volátiles costos de envío que afectan directamente los precios de los productos.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **Transporte de línea**: Servicio oceánico programado en rutas fijas, principalmente para contenedores, abierto a muchos cargadores.

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **Transporte tramp**: Servicio oceánico no programado en el que los barcos se fletan para transportar carga, generalmente a granel, a donde sea necesario.

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **Póliza de fletamento (Charter party)**: El contrato para alquilar un barco (por viaje, tiempo o casco desnudo).

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **Alianza naviera**: Un grupo de transportistas de contenedores que comparten espacio en los buques y coordinan servicios sin fijar precios.

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: Un contenedor estándar de 40 pies, la unidad habitual para cotizar tarifas de flete de contenedores.

ar.title: [الخدمات اللوجستية الدولية #3] الحافلات مقابل سيارات الأجرة في المحيط: كيف يعمل سوق الشحن حقاً

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > ينقسم الشحن البحري إلى سوقين، خدمة "الخطوط الملاحية المنتظمة" المجدولة وخدمة "الشحن العارض" عند الطلب. تتشارك تحالفات شركات النقل في السفن، وتتتبع مؤشرات الشحن تكلفة نقل البضائع.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## مفهوم اليوم

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: يتم نقل حوالي 80% من التجارة العالمية من حيث الحجم عن طريق البحر، لكن "الشحن" ليس سوقاً واحداً.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: إنه في الواقع سوقان، ويعملان بقواعد مختلفة.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: شحن الخطوط الملاحية المنتظمة: حافلة المحيط.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: تدير شركات الخطوط الملاحية المنتظمة طرقاً ثابتة وفق جداول زمنية معلنة.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: تغادر السفينة شنغهاي كل أسبوع سواء كانت ممتلئة أم لا، وتتوقف في نفس الموانئ بنفس الترتيب.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: تحمل الخطوط الملاحية في الغالب **حاويات** من البضائع المصنعة مثل الإلكترونيات والملابس والأثاث وقطع غيار السيارات.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: يتشارك الآلاف من الشاحنين في كل سفينة، تماماً مثل الركاب في الحافلة.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: عادة ما يدفع الشاحنون الصغار أسعاراً تحددها شركة النقل أو وكيل الشحن.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: يتفاوض الشاحنون الكبار على **عقود خدمة** سنوية.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: الشحن العارض: سيارة أجرة المحيط.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: سفن الشحن العارض ليس لديها جدول زمني ثابت.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: تذهب إلى أي مكان يحتاج مالك البضاعة أن تذهب إليه.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: وهي تحمل بشكل رئيسي سلعاً **سائبة** مثل خام الحديد والفحم والحبوب والنفط الخام، وغالباً ما تملأ السفينة بأكملها بشحنة واحدة.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: تسمى الصفقة **عقد استئجار**، وهناك ثلاثة أنواع رئيسية:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **استئجار بالرحلة**: تدفع مقابل نقل شحنة واحدة من الميناء أ إلى الميناء ب.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **استئجار بالزمن**: تستأجر السفينة وطاقمها لفترة محددة.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **استئجار بدون طاقم (Bareboat)**: تستأجر السفينة فقط وتوفر طاقمك وعملياتك الخاصة.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **تحالفات الشحن.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: يمكن لسفينة حاويات حديثة أن تحمل أكثر من 20,000 حاوية، وتشغيل خدمة أسبوعية يتطلب العديد منها.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: لملء هذه المساحة الكبيرة، تشكل شركات النقل **تحالفات**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: يتشارك الأعضاء المساحة على سفن بعضهم البعض من خلال اتفاقيات مشاركة السفن، مما يسمح لهم بتقديم طرق ورحلات أكثر مما يمكن لأي منهم تشغيله بمفرده.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: تتشارك التحالفات في *السفن*، لكنها لا تحدد *الأسعار* معاً؛ لا تزال كل شركة نقل تحدد أسعارها الخاصة.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: هذا يجعلها مختلفة عن **مؤتمرات الخطوط الملاحية** القديمة، التي كانت تحدد الأسعار بالفعل.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: حظر الاتحاد الأوروبي المؤتمرات في عام 2008.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: في الولايات المتحدة، يتم تقديم اتفاقيات شركات النقل إلى اللجنة البحرية الفيدرالية (FMC) والإشراف عليها من قبلها.

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: اعتباراً من عام 2025، كانت المجموعات الرئيسية هي **Gemini Cooperation** (ميرسك وهاباج لويد)، و **Ocean Alliance** (سي إم إيه سي جي إم، كوسكو/أو أو سي إل، وإيفرجرين)، و **Premier Alliance** (وان، إتش إم إم، ويانغ مينغ).

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: تعمل **MSC**، أكبر خط حاويات في العالم، بمفردها.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: تتغير عضوية التحالف كل بضع سنوات، لذا تحقق من التشكيلات الحالية قبل الاعتماد عليها.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **مؤشرات الشحن.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: تتأرجح أسعار الشحن بشكل كبير، لذا تتبعها الصناعة بمؤشرات:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **مؤشر البلطيق الجاف (BDI)**: ينشره بورصة البلطيق في لندن. وهو يتتبع تكلفة استئجار سفن البضائع الجافة السائبة وغالباً ما يُقرأ كإشارة على الطلب على المواد الخام.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **مؤشر شنغهاي لشحن الحاويات (SCFI)**: أسعار الحاويات الفورية للطرق الخارجة من شنغهاي.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **مؤشر دروري العالمي للحاويات (WCI)** و **مؤشر فريتوس البلطيق (FBX)**: أسعار الحاويات الفورية على الطرق الرئيسية بين الشرق والغرب، وعادة ما يتم تسعيرها لكل حاوية 40 قدماً (FEU).

segments.tr: تخيل مستورد أثاث متوسط الحجم في دالاس يشتري أرائك من مصنع بالقرب من شنغهاي.

segments.tr: لدى المستورد عقد خدمة سنوي مع شركة نقل واحدة، بالإضافة إلى وكيل لحجز مساحة إضافية في السوق الفورية خلال الأشهر المزدحمة.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: في عام 2021، ارتفع الطلب خلال الجائحة وتكدست الموانئ.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: ارتفعت الأسعار الفورية من الصين إلى الساحل الغربي للولايات المتحدة، مقاسة بمؤشرات مثل FBX، إلى أكثر من **20,000 دولار لكل حاوية 40 قدماً**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: شهد المستوردون الذين اعتمدوا على السوق الفورية قفزة في تكاليف الشحن، مما دفع أسعار التجزئة للارتفاع.

segments.tr: كان المستوردون الذين لديهم عقود محميين بشكل أفضل، وإن لم يكن دائماً، لأن بعض شركات النقل كافحت للوفاء بكل مساحة متعاقد عليها.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، يستخدم مصدر حبوب في نيو أورلينز يشحن فول الصويا إلى آسيا سوق **الشحن العارض**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: إنه يستأجر سفينة بضائع سائبة كاملة، ويراقب **مؤشر البلطيق الجاف** بدلاً من مؤشرات الحاويات.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: نفس المحيط، أسواق مختلفة.

fr.title: [Logistique internationale n°3] Bus vs. Taxis sur l'océan : Comment fonctionne réellement le marché du transport maritime

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > Le transport maritime se divise en deux marchés : le service « régulier » (liner) et le service « à la demande » (tramp). Les alliances de transporteurs partagent des navires, et les indices de fret suivent le coût du transport des marchandises.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: Environ 80 % du commerce mondial en volume transite par la mer, mais le « transport maritime » n'est pas un marché unique.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: Il s'agit en réalité de deux marchés, régis par des règles différentes.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: Transport maritime régulier (Liner) : le bus des océans.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: Les transporteurs réguliers exploitent des itinéraires fixes selon des horaires publiés.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: Un navire quitte Shanghai chaque semaine, qu'il soit plein ou non, et il fait escale dans les mêmes ports, dans le même ordre.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: Les navires réguliers transportent principalement des **conteneurs** de produits manufacturés tels que l'électronique, les vêtements, les meubles et les pièces automobiles.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: Des milliers d'expéditeurs partagent chaque navire, un peu comme des passagers dans un bus.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Les petits expéditeurs paient généralement les tarifs indiqués par le transporteur ou un transitaire.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: Les grands expéditeurs négocient des **contrats de service** annuels.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: Transport maritime à la demande (Tramp) : le taxi des océans.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: Les navires « tramp » n'ont pas d'horaire fixe.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: Ils vont là où le propriétaire de la cargaison a besoin qu'ils aillent.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: Ils transportent principalement des produits de base en **vrac** tels que le minerai de fer, le charbon, les céréales et le pétrole brut, remplissant souvent tout le navire avec une seule cargaison.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: L'accord est appelé **affrètement**, et il en existe trois types principaux :

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **Affrètement au voyage (Voyage charter)** : vous payez pour déplacer une cargaison du port A au port B.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **Affrètement à temps (Time charter)** : vous louez le navire et son équipage pour une période déterminée.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **Affrètement coque nue (Bareboat charter)** : vous louez uniquement le navire et fournissez votre propre équipage et vos opérations.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **Alliances maritimes.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: Un porte-conteneurs moderne peut transporter plus de 20 000 conteneurs, et assurer un service hebdomadaire en nécessite plusieurs.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: Pour remplir autant d'espace, les transporteurs forment des **alliances**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: Les membres partagent l'espace sur les navires des uns et des autres grâce à des accords de partage de navires, ce qui leur permet d'offrir plus d'itinéraires et de traversées que ce que chacun pourrait assurer seul.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: Les alliances partagent les *navires*, mais elles ne fixent pas les *prix* ensemble ; chaque transporteur définit toujours ses propres tarifs.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: Cela les distingue des anciennes **conférences maritimes**, qui fixaient effectivement les prix.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: L'UE a interdit les conférences en 2008.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: Aux États-Unis, les accords entre transporteurs sont déposés auprès de la Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) et supervisés par celle-ci.

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: En 2025, les principaux groupements étaient la **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk et Hapag-Lloyd), l'**Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL et Evergreen), et la **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM et Yang Ming).

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**, la plus grande compagnie de porte-conteneurs au monde, opère seule.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: L'adhésion aux alliances change tous les quelques années, vérifiez donc les compositions actuelles avant de vous y fier.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **Indices de fret.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: Les prix du transport maritime fluctuent considérablement, c'est pourquoi l'industrie les suit à l'aide d'indices :

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)** : publié par le Baltic Exchange de Londres. Il suit le coût de l'affrètement des navires vraquiers secs et est souvent interprété comme un signal de la demande en matières premières.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)** : tarifs spot des conteneurs pour les itinéraires au départ de Shanghai.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** et **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)** : tarifs spot des conteneurs sur les principaux itinéraires est-ouest, généralement cotés par conteneur de 40 pieds (FEU).

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Imaginez un importateur de meubles de taille moyenne à Dallas qui achète des canapés auprès d'une usine près de Shanghai.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: Ses marchandises voyagent par **ligne régulière** : les conteneurs sont expédiés chaque semaine vers le port de Los Angeles/Long Beach, puis acheminés par rail jusqu'au Texas.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: L'importateur a un contrat de service annuel avec un transporteur, ainsi qu'un transitaire pour réserver de l'espace supplémentaire sur le marché spot pendant les mois chargés.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: En 2021, la demande a bondi pendant la pandémie et les ports ont été saturés.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: Les tarifs spot de la Chine vers la côte ouest des États-Unis, mesurés par des indices comme le FBX, ont grimpé au-dessus de **20 000 $ par conteneur de 40 pieds**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Avant la pandémie, ils étaient généralement inférieurs à 2 000 $.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Les importateurs qui dépendaient du marché spot ont vu leurs coûts d'expédition augmenter, ce qui a fait grimper les prix de détail.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Les importateurs sous contrat étaient mieux protégés, bien que pas toujours, car certains transporteurs ont eu du mal à honorer chaque emplacement contractuel.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, un exportateur de céréales à la Nouvelle-Orléans expédiant du soja vers l'Asie utilise le marché **tramp**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Il affrète un navire vraquier entier et surveille le **Baltic Dry Index** plutôt que les indices de conteneurs.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Même océan, marchés différents.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 lignes

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. Le transport **régulier (Liner)** assure des itinéraires fixes et programmés pour les marchandises conteneurisées (le bus). Le transport **à la demande (Tramp)** est affrété pour les cargaisons en vrac (le taxi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. Les **alliances** permettent aux transporteurs de conteneurs de partager l'espace des navires pour offrir des réseaux plus larges, mais contrairement aux anciennes conférences, elles ne fixent pas les prix.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. Les **indices de fret** comme le BDI (vrac) et le SCFI, WCI et FBX (conteneurs) suivent les coûts de transport volatils qui affectent directement les prix des produits.

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: publicado pela Baltic Exchange de Londres. Ele rastreia o custo de afretamento de navios de carga seca a granel e é frequentemente lido como um sinal da demanda por matérias-primas.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: tarifas spot de contêineres para rotas saindo de Xangai.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** e **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: tarifas spot de contêineres nas principais rotas leste-oeste, geralmente cotadas por contêiner de 40 pés (FEU).

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Na Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Imagine um importador de móveis de médio porte em Dallas que compra sofás de uma fábrica perto de Xangai.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: Suas mercadorias viajam por **linha (liner)**: os contêineres são enviados semanalmente para o Porto de Los Angeles/Long Beach e, em seguida, vão por ferrovia para o Texas.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: O importador tem um contrato de serviço anual com uma transportadora, além de um agente de carga para reservar espaço extra no mercado spot durante os meses de maior movimento.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: Em 2021, a demanda aumentou durante a pandemia e os portos ficaram congestionados.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: As taxas spot da China para a costa oeste dos EUA, medidas por índices como o FBX, subiram acima de **US$ 20.000 por contêiner de 40 pés**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Antes da pandemia, costumavam ficar abaixo de US$ 2.000.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Importadores que dependiam do mercado spot viram os custos de frete dispararem, o que pressionou para cima os preços no varejo.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Importadores com contrato estavam mais protegidos, embora nem sempre, porque algumas transportadoras tiveram dificuldade para honrar todos os espaços contratados.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, um exportador de grãos em Nova Orleans que envia soja para a Ásia usa o mercado **tramp**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Ele afreta um navio graneleiro inteiro e acompanha o **Baltic Dry Index**, e não os índices de contêineres.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Mesmo oceano, mercados diferentes.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumo em 3 linhas

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. A navegação **de linha regular** opera rotas fixas e programadas para cargas conteinerizadas (o ônibus). A navegação **tramp** é afretada sob demanda para cargas a granel (o táxi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. As **alianças** permitem que transportadoras de contêineres compartilhem espaço nos navios para oferecer redes mais amplas, mas, diferentemente das antigas conferências, não fixam preços.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. Índices de frete como o BDI (granel) e o SCFI, o WCI e o FBX (contêineres) acompanham custos de transporte voláteis que afetam diretamente os preços dos produtos.
