in.title: [International Logistics #3] Bus vs. Taksi di Laut: Cara Kerja Pasar Pelayaran yang Sebenarnya

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > Pelayaran laut terbagi menjadi dua pasar, layanan terjadwal “liner” dan layanan sesuai permintaan “tramp”. Aliansi operator pelayaran berbagi kapal, dan indeks angkutan melacak biaya untuk memindahkan barang.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: Sekitar 80% perdagangan dunia menurut volume diangkut melalui laut, tetapi “pelayaran” bukan satu pasar.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: Sebenarnya ada dua, dan keduanya berjalan dengan aturan yang berbeda.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: Pelayaran liner: bus laut.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: Operator liner menjalankan rute tetap dengan jadwal yang dipublikasikan.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: Sebuah kapal berangkat dari Shanghai setiap minggu, baik penuh maupun tidak, dan singgah di pelabuhan yang sama dengan urutan yang sama.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: Liner terutama mengangkut **kontainer** berisi barang manufaktur seperti elektronik, pakaian, furnitur, dan suku cadang otomotif.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: Ribuan pengirim berbagi setiap kapal, mirip penumpang di dalam bus.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Pengirim kecil biasanya membayar tarif yang ditetapkan oleh operator atau freight forwarder.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: Pengirim besar menegosiasikan **kontrak layanan** tahunan.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: Pelayaran tramp: taksi laut.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: Kapal tramp tidak memiliki jadwal tetap.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: Kapal tersebut pergi ke mana pun pemilik kargo membutuhkannya.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: Kapal tramp terutama mengangkut komoditas **curah** seperti bijih besi, batu bara, gandum, dan minyak mentah, sering kali memenuhi seluruh kapal dengan satu jenis kargo.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: Kesepakatannya disebut **charter**, dan ada tiga jenis utama:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **Voyage charter**: Anda membayar untuk mengangkut satu kargo dari pelabuhan A ke pelabuhan B.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **Time charter**: Anda menyewa kapal beserta awaknya untuk jangka waktu tertentu.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **Bareboat charter**: Anda hanya menyewa kapal dan menyediakan awak serta operasinya sendiri.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **Aliansi pelayaran.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: Kapal kontainer modern dapat mengangkut lebih dari 20.000 kontainer, dan menjalankan layanan mingguan membutuhkan beberapa kapal sekaligus.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: Untuk mengisi ruang sebanyak itu, operator membentuk **aliansi**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: Anggota berbagi ruang di kapal satu sama lain melalui perjanjian berbagi kapal, yang memungkinkan mereka menawarkan lebih banyak rute dan pelayaran daripada yang dapat dijalankan sendiri.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: Aliansi berbagi *kapal*, tetapi mereka tidak menetapkan *harga* bersama; setiap operator tetap menentukan tarifnya sendiri.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: Hal ini berbeda dari **konferensi liner** yang lebih lama, yang memang menetapkan harga.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: Uni Eropa melarang konferensi pada tahun 2008.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: Di AS, perjanjian operator didaftarkan ke dan diawasi oleh Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: Per 2025, pengelompokan utamanya adalah **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk dan Hapag-Lloyd), **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, dan Evergreen), serta **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, dan Yang Ming).

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**, operator kontainer terbesar di dunia, beroperasi sendiri.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: Keanggotaan aliansi berubah setiap beberapa tahun, jadi periksa susunan terkini sebelum mengandalkannya.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **Indeks angkutan.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: Harga pelayaran berfluktuasi tajam, sehingga industri memantaunya melalui indeks:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: diterbitkan oleh Baltic Exchange di London. Indeks ini melacak biaya charter kapal curah kering dan sering dibaca sebagai sinyal permintaan bahan mentah.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: tarif spot kontainer untuk rute dari Shanghai.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** dan **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: tarif spot kontainer pada rute timur-barat utama, biasanya dikutip per kontainer 40 kaki (FEU).

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Bayangkan seorang importir furnitur berskala menengah di Dallas yang membeli sofa dari pabrik di dekat Shanghai.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: Barangnya diangkut dengan **liner**: kontainer dikirim setiap minggu ke Pelabuhan Los Angeles/Long Beach, lalu dibawa dengan kereta api ke Texas.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: Importir ini memiliki kontrak layanan tahunan dengan satu operator, ditambah sebuah forwarder untuk memesan ruang tambahan di pasar spot selama bulan-bulan sibuk.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: Pada 2021, permintaan melonjak selama pandemi dan pelabuhan menumpuk.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: Tarif spot dari China ke pantai barat AS, yang diukur dengan indeks seperti FBX, naik di atas **$20.000 per kontainer 40 kaki**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Sebelum pandemi, tarifnya biasanya di bawah $2.000.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Importir yang mengandalkan pasar spot melihat biaya pengiriman melonjak, yang kemudian mendorong naik harga ritel.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Importir dengan kontrak lebih terlindungi, meskipun tidak selalu, karena beberapa operator kesulitan memenuhi setiap slot yang telah dikontrak.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, eksportir gandum di New Orleans yang mengirim kedelai ke Asia menggunakan pasar **tramp**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Eksportir ini mencharter satu kapal curah utuh, dan memantau **Baltic Dry Index** alih-alih indeks kontainer.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Laut yang sama, pasar yang berbeda.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **Liner** beroperasi pada rute tetap yang terjadwal untuk barang kontainer (bus). **Tramp** dicharter sesuai permintaan untuk kargo curah (taksi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Aliansi** memungkinkan operator kontainer berbagi ruang kapal untuk menawarkan jaringan yang lebih luas, tetapi tidak seperti konferensi lama, mereka tidak menetapkan harga.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. **Indeks angkutan** seperti BDI (curah) serta SCFI, WCI, dan FBX (kontainer) melacak biaya pengiriman yang fluktuatif dan berdampak langsung pada harga produk.

segments.tr: 世界の貿易量の約80%は海上輸送によって運ばれていますが、「海運」は一つの市場ではありません。

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: 実際には二つの市場があり、それぞれ異なるルールで動いています。

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: 定期船：海のバス。**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: 定期船の運航会社は、公表されたスケジュールに従って固定ルートを運航します。

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: 例えば上海からは、満船かどうかに関係なく毎週船が出港し、同じ港に同じ順番で寄港します。

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: 定期船は主に、電子機器、衣料品、家具、自動車部品などの製造品を**コンテナ**で運びます。

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: 何千もの荷主が一隻の船を共有するのは、バスに多くの乗客が乗るのに似ています。

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 小規模な荷主は通常、運航会社または貨物運送取扱業者（フレイトフォワーダー）が提示する運賃を支払います。

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: 大規模な荷主は年間の**サービス契約**を交渉します。

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: 不定期船：海のタクシー。**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: 不定期船には決まった運航スケジュールがありません。

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: 貨物の所有者が必要とする場所へ向かいます。

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: 主に鉄鉱石、石炭、穀物、原油などの**ばら積み**貨物を運び、一隻を一つの貨物で満載にすることも多くあります。

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: この契約は**用船（チャーター）**と呼ばれ、主に三つの種類があります。

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **航海用船**：ある貨物をA港からB港まで運ぶために料金を支払います。

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **期間用船**：一定期間、船と乗組員を借りる契約です。

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **裸用船**：船のみを借り、乗組員と運航に必要な業務はご自身で用意します。

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **海運アライアンス。**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: 現代のコンテナ船は2万個以上のコンテナを積載でき、週次サービスを運航するには複数の船舶が必要です。

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: これほど大きな積載スペースを埋めるため、運航会社は**アライアンス**を結成します。

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: 加盟会社は船腹共有契約により互いの船舶に積載スペースを共有し、単独では運航できないより多くの航路と便を提供できます。

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: アライアンスは*船舶*は共有しますが、*運賃*は共同で設定しません。各社が自社の運賃を決めます。

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: これは、運賃を実際に協定していた従来の**定期船協議会（コンファレンス）**とは異なる点です。

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: EUは2008年にコンファレンスを禁止しました。

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: 米国では、運航会社間の協定は連邦海事委員会（FMC）に届け出られ、その監督を受けます。

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: 2025年時点の主な提携グループは、**ジェミニ・コーペレーション**（マースクとハパッグ・ロイド）、**オーシャン・アライアンス**（CMA CGM、COSCO/OOCL、エバーグリーン）、**プレミア・アライアンス**（ONE、HMM、陽明海運）でした。

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: 世界最大のコンテナ船社である**MSC**は、独自に運航しています。

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: アライアンスの加盟関係は数年ごとに変わるため、頼りにする前に最新の顔ぶれを確認してください。

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **運賃指数。**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: 海運の運賃は大きく変動するため、業界では指数を使って動向を追跡します：

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **バルチック海運指数（BDI）**：ロンドンのバルチック取引所が公表しています。ばら積み船の用船料を示し、原材料需要のシグナルとして読まれることが多い指数です。

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **上海コンテナ運賃指数（SCFI）**：上海発の航路におけるスポットのコンテナ運賃を示します。

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **ドリュー世界コンテナ指数（WCI）**と**フレイトス・バルチック指数（FBX）**：主要な東西航路のスポットのコンテナ運賃で、通常は40フィートコンテナ（FEU）単位で示されます。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活で見ると

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: ダラスにある中規模の家具輸入業者が、上海近郊の工場からソファを仕入れている場面を想像してください。

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: その商品は**定期船**で輸送されます：コンテナが毎週ロサンゼルス／ロングビーチ港へ向けて出荷され、そこから鉄道でテキサスまで運ばれます。

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: この輸入業者は一社と年間サービス契約を結び、繁忙期にはスポット市場で追加のスペースを予約するため運送取扱業者も利用しています。

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: 2021年にはパンデミックの最中に需要が急増し、港が混雑しました。

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: FBXなどの指数で測定される、中国から米国西海岸向けのスポット運賃は、**40フィートコンテナ1本あたり2万ドル**を超えました。

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: パンデミック前は通常2,000ドル未満でした。

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: スポット市場に頼っていた輸入業者は輸送コストの急騰に直面し、それが小売価格を押し上げました。

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: 契約を結んでいた輸入業者は比較的守られていましたが、常にそうとは限りませんでした。一部の運航会社は、契約したスペースをすべて確保することに苦労したためです。

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: 一方、ニューオーリンズで大豆をアジアへ輸出する穀物輸出業者は、**不定期船**市場を利用します。

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: 同社はばら積み船を一隻丸ごと用船し、コンテナ指数ではなく**バルチック海運指数**を注視します。

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: 同じ海でも、市場は異なります。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行まとめ

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **定期船**は、コンテナ貨物を固定された定期ルートで運びます（バス）。**不定期船**は、需要に応じて船を用船し、主にばら積み貨物を運びます（タクシー）。

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **アライアンス**によりコンテナ船社は船腹を共有し、より広いネットワークを提供できますが、従来のコンファレンスと違い、運賃は協定しません。

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. **BDI**（ばら積み）や**SCFI、WCI、FBX**（コンテナ）などの運賃指数は、製品価格に直接影響する変動の激しい輸送コストを示します。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己確認クイズ

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **定期船**：固定ルートで行われる予定どおりの海上サービスで、主にコンテナを扱い、多くの荷主に開かれています。

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **不定期船**：必要な場所へ貨物（通常はばら積み貨物）を運ぶために船を用船する、スケジュールのない海上サービスです。

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **用船契約**：船を借りるための契約です（航海用船、期間用船、裸用船のいずれか）。

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **海運アライアンス**：船腹を共有し、運賃を協定せずにサービスを調整するコンテナ船社のグループです。

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU（40フィート・コンテナ換算単位）**：標準的な40フィートコンテナで、コンテナ運賃の見積もりに通常使われる単位です。

segments.tr: *解答：Q1 – C。

segments.src: Renting a ship with its crew for a set period is a time charter.
segments.tr: 一定期間、乗組員付きで船を借りるのは期間用船です。

segments.src: A voyage charter covers a single trip, and a bareboat charter excludes the crew.
segments.tr: 航海用船は単一の航海を対象とし、裸用船は乗組員を含みません。

segments.src: Q2 – False.
Alliances share vessel space and schedules, but each carrier sets its own prices.
segments.tr: アライアンスは船腹と運航スケジュールを共有しますが、運賃は各社が自ら設定します。

segments.src: Joint price-fixing was the feature of the old liner conferences.
segments.tr: 共同での運賃協定は、従来の定期船コンファレンスの特徴でした。

segments.tr: Q3 – B。

segments.tr: バルチック海運指数は、ばら積み貨物船の用船料を追跡します。

segments.tr: 残りの三つはコンテナ運賃を追跡します。*

de.title: [Internationale Logistik #3] Busse vs. Taxis auf dem Ozean: So funktioniert der Schifffahrtsmarkt wirklich

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > Die Seeschifffahrt gliedert sich in zwei Märkte: den planmäßigen „Liner“-Verkehr und den bedarfsabhängigen „Tramp“-Verkehr. Reederei-Allianzen teilen sich Schiffe, und Frachtindizes verfolgen, was der Transport von Waren kostet.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: Rund 80 % des Welthandels nach Volumen werden auf dem Seeweg transportiert, doch „Schifffahrt“ ist kein einheitlicher Markt.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: Es sind eigentlich zwei, und sie folgen unterschiedlichen Regeln.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: Linienschifffahrt: der Ozean-Bus.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: Linienreedereien betreiben feste Routen nach veröffentlichten Fahrplänen.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: Ein Schiff verlässt Shanghai jede Woche, ob voll oder nicht, und es fährt dieselben Häfen in derselben Reihenfolge an.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: Linienschiffe befördern meist **Container** mit Industriegütern wie Elektronik, Kleidung, Möbeln und Autoteilen.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: Tausende Versender teilen sich jedes Schiff, ähnlich wie Fahrgäste in einem Bus.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Kleine Versender zahlen in der Regel Tarife, die von der Reederei oder einem Spediteur angeboten werden.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: Große Versender handeln jährliche **Serviceverträge** aus.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: Trampschifffahrt: das Ozean-Taxi.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: Trampschiffe haben keinen festen Fahrplan.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: Sie fahren dorthin, wohin der Ladungseigner sie braucht.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: Sie transportieren vor allem **Massengüter** wie Eisenerz, Kohle, Getreide und Rohöl, oft ein ganzes Schiff voll mit nur einer Ladung.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: Das Geschäft heißt **Charter**; es gibt drei Haupttypen:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **Reisecharter**: Sie zahlen, um eine Ladung von Hafen A nach Hafen B zu bringen.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **Zeitcharter**: Sie mieten das Schiff und die Besatzung für einen festgelegten Zeitraum.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **Bareboat-Charter**: Sie mieten nur das Schiff und stellen Besatzung und Betrieb selbst.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **Schifffahrtsallianzen.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: Ein modernes Containerschiff kann mehr als 20.000 Container laden, und für einen wöchentlichen Liniendienst braucht man mehrere Schiffe.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: Um so viel Kapazität zu füllen, bilden Reedereien **Allianzen**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: Die Mitglieder nutzen gegenseitig Stellplätze auf ihren Schiffen im Rahmen von Schiffsteilungsabkommen (Vessel-Sharing-Agreements), wodurch sie mehr Routen und Abfahrten anbieten können, als jede Einzelne allein betreiben könnte.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: Allianzen teilen *Schiffe*, aber sie legen die *Preise* nicht gemeinsam fest; jede Reederei setzt weiterhin ihre eigenen Tarife.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: Damit unterscheiden sie sich von den älteren **Linienkonferenzen**, die Preise tatsächlich abgesprochen haben.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: Die EU hat Konferenzen 2008 verboten.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: In den USA werden Reedereivereinbarungen bei der Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) eingereicht und von ihr überwacht.

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).

segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.tr: 2021 stieg die Nachfrage während der Pandemie stark an, und in den Häfen staute es sich.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: Die Spotraten von China zur US-Westküste, gemessen an Indizes wie dem FBX, kletterten über **20.000 US-Dollar pro 40-Fuß-Container**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Vor der Pandemie lagen sie typischerweise unter 2.000 US-Dollar.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Importeure, die sich auf den Spotmarkt verließen, erlebten einen Sprung bei den Versandkosten, was die Einzelhandelspreise steigen ließ.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Importeure mit Verträgen waren besser geschützt, wenn auch nicht immer, denn manche Reedereien hatten Mühe, jeden vereinbarten Slot einzuhalten.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Unterdessen nutzt ein Getreideexporteur in New Orleans, der Sojabohnen nach Asien verschifft, den **Trampmarkt**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Er chartert ein ganzes Massengutschiff und beobachtet den **Baltic Dry Index** statt der Containerindizes.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Derselbe Ozean, verschiedene Märkte.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: 1. **Liner** shipping runs fixed, scheduled routes for containerized goods (the bus). **Tramp** shipping is chartered on demand for bulk cargo (the taxi).
segments.tr: 1. **Linienschifffahrt** bedient feste, planmäßige Routen für containerisierte Güter (der Bus). **Trampschifffahrt** wird bedarfsabhängig für Massengut gechartert (das Taxi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Allianzen** erlauben Containerreedereien, Schiffsraum zu teilen, um breitere Netze anzubieten; anders als die früheren Konferenzen legen sie aber keine Preise fest.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. **Frachtindizes** wie der BDI (Massengut) sowie SCFI, WCI und FBX (Container) verfolgen volatile Frachtkosten, die sich direkt auf Produktpreise auswirken.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.
segments.tr: - **Linienschifffahrt**: Planmäßiger Seeverkehr auf festen Routen, hauptsächlich für Container, offen für viele Versender.

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.
segments.tr: - **Trampschifffahrt**: Nicht planmäßiger Seeverkehr, bei dem Schiffe gechartert werden, um Fracht, meist Massengut, dorthin zu bringen, wo sie benötigt wird.

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).

vi.title: [International Logistics #3] Tàu buýt và taxi trên biển: thị trường vận tải biển thực sự vận hành như thế nào

segments.src: > Ocean shipping splits into two markets, scheduled "liner" service and on-demand "tramp" service. Carrier alliances share ships, and freight indexes track what it costs to move goods.
segments.tr: > Vận tải biển được chia thành hai thị trường: dịch vụ theo lịch cố định "liner" và dịch vụ theo yêu cầu "tramp". Các liên minh hãng tàu chia sẻ tàu, còn các chỉ số cước vận tải theo dõi chi phí vận chuyển hàng hóa.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: About 80% of world trade by volume travels by sea, but "shipping" isn't one market.
segments.tr: Khoảng 80% khối lượng thương mại thế giới được vận chuyển bằng đường biển, nhưng "vận tải biển" không phải là một thị trường duy nhất.

segments.src: It's really two, and they run on different rules.
segments.tr: Thực tế có hai thị trường, và chúng vận hành theo những quy tắc khác nhau.

segments.src: Liner shipping: the ocean bus.**
segments.tr: Vận tải liner: xe buýt đại dương.**

segments.src: Liner carriers run fixed routes on published schedules.
segments.tr: Các hãng tàu liner khai thác các tuyến cố định theo lịch trình đã công bố.

segments.src: A ship leaves Shanghai every week whether it's full or not, and it calls at the same ports in the same order.
segments.tr: Một con tàu rời Thượng Hải mỗi tuần, bất kể có đầy hàng hay không, và ghé các cảng giống nhau theo cùng một thứ tự.

segments.src: Liners mostly carry **containers** of manufactured goods like electronics, clothing, furniture, and auto parts.
segments.tr: Tàu liner chủ yếu chở **container** các hàng hóa công nghiệp như điện tử, quần áo, đồ nội thất và phụ tùng ô tô.

segments.src: Thousands of shippers share each vessel, much like passengers on a bus.
segments.tr: Hàng nghìn chủ hàng cùng chia sẻ mỗi con tàu, giống như hành khách trên xe buýt.

segments.src: Small shippers usually pay rates quoted by the carrier or a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Các chủ hàng nhỏ thường trả mức cước do hãng tàu hoặc công ty giao nhận báo.

segments.src: Large shippers negotiate annual **service contracts**.
segments.tr: Các chủ hàng lớn thương lượng **hợp đồng dịch vụ** hằng năm.

segments.src: Tramp shipping: the ocean taxi.**
segments.tr: Vận tải tramp: taxi đại dương.**

segments.src: Tramp ships have no fixed schedule.
segments.tr: Tàu tramp không có lịch trình cố định.

segments.src: They go wherever a cargo owner needs them to go.
segments.tr: Chúng đi bất cứ nơi nào chủ hàng cần.

segments.src: They mainly carry **bulk** commodities such as iron ore, coal, grain, and crude oil, often filling the whole ship with a single cargo.
segments.tr: Chúng chủ yếu chở hàng **rời** như quặng sắt, than, ngũ cốc và dầu thô, thường chất đầy cả con tàu chỉ với một loại hàng.

segments.src: The deal is called a **charter**, and there are three main types:
segments.tr: Hợp đồng này gọi là **thuê tàu chuyến (charter)**, và có ba loại chính:

segments.src: - **Voyage charter**: you pay to move one cargo from port A to port B.
segments.tr: - **Thuê tàu theo chuyến (voyage charter)**: bạn trả tiền để vận chuyển một lô hàng từ cảng A đến cảng B.

segments.src: - **Time charter**: you rent the ship and its crew for a set period.
segments.tr: - **Thuê tàu theo thời hạn (time charter)**: bạn thuê tàu cùng thuyền viên trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định.

segments.src: - **Bareboat charter**: you rent only the ship and supply your own crew and operations.
segments.tr: - **Thuê trần (bareboat charter)**: bạn chỉ thuê tàu và tự cung cấp thuyền viên cùng việc vận hành.

segments.src: **Shipping alliances.**
segments.tr: **Liên minh hãng tàu.**

segments.src: A modern container ship can carry more than 20,000 containers, and running a weekly service needs several of them.
segments.tr: Một tàu container hiện đại có thể chở hơn 20.000 container, và để duy trì dịch vụ hằng tuần cần nhiều tàu như vậy.

segments.src: To fill that much space, carriers form **alliances**.
segments.tr: Để lấp đầy từng ấy không gian, các hãng tàu lập thành **liên minh**.

segments.src: Members share space on each other's vessels through vessel-sharing agreements, which lets them offer more routes and sailings than any one of them could run alone.
segments.tr: Các thành viên chia sẻ không gian trên tàu của nhau thông qua thỏa thuận chia sẻ tàu, nhờ đó họ có thể cung cấp nhiều tuyến và chuyến hơn bất kỳ hãng nào tự khai thác riêng lẻ.

segments.src: Alliances share *ships*, but they don't set *prices* together; each carrier still sets its own rates.
segments.tr: Liên minh chia sẻ *tàu*, nhưng không cùng định *giá*; mỗi hãng vẫn tự quyết định mức cước của mình.

segments.src: That makes them different from the older **liner conferences**, which did fix prices.
segments.tr: Điều này khác với các **hiệp hội liner (liner conference)** trước đây, vốn có ấn định giá.

segments.src: The EU banned conferences in 2008.
segments.tr: EU đã cấm các hiệp hội này vào năm 2008.

segments.src: In the US, carrier agreements are filed with and overseen by the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC).
segments.tr: Tại Mỹ, các thỏa thuận của hãng tàu được nộp cho và chịu sự giám sát của Ủy ban Hàng hải Liên bang (FMC).

segments.src: As of 2025, the main groupings were the **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL, and Evergreen), and the **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM, and Yang Ming).
segments.tr: Tính đến năm 2025, các nhóm chính gồm **Gemini Cooperation** (Maersk và Hapag-Lloyd), **Ocean Alliance** (CMA CGM, COSCO/OOCL và Evergreen) và **Premier Alliance** (ONE, HMM và Yang Ming).

segments.src: **MSC**, the world's largest container line, operates on its own.
segments.tr: **MSC**, hãng container lớn nhất thế giới, hoạt động độc lập.

segments.src: Alliance membership changes every few years, so check current lineups before relying on them.
segments.tr: Thành viên liên minh thay đổi vài năm một lần, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra đội hình hiện tại trước khi dựa vào thông tin này.

segments.src: **Freight indexes.**
segments.tr: **Các chỉ số cước vận tải.**

segments.src: Shipping prices swing widely, so the industry tracks them with indexes:
segments.tr: Giá cước vận tải biến động mạnh, nên ngành theo dõi chúng bằng các chỉ số:

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by London's Baltic Exchange. It tracks the cost of chartering dry bulk ships and is often read as a signal of raw-material demand.
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: do Sàn Baltic ở London công bố. Chỉ số này theo dõi chi phí thuê tàu chở hàng rời khô và thường được xem như tín hiệu về nhu cầu nguyên liệu thô.

segments.src: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: spot container rates for routes out of Shanghai.
segments.tr: - **Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI)**: cước container giao ngay trên các tuyến xuất phát từ Thượng Hải.

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** and **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: spot container rates on major east-west routes, usually quoted per 40-foot container (FEU).
segments.tr: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)** và **Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)**: cước container giao ngay trên các tuyến đông–tây chính, thường được báo theo container 40 feet (FEU).

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong đời sống hằng ngày

segments.src: Picture a mid-sized furniture importer in Dallas that buys sofas from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Hãy hình dung một nhà nhập khẩu đồ nội thất quy mô vừa ở Dallas, mua ghế sofa từ một nhà máy gần Thượng Hải.

segments.src: Its goods travel by **liner**: containers ship weekly to the Port of Los Angeles/Long Beach, then go by rail to Texas.
segments.tr: Hàng của họ được vận chuyển bằng **liner**: container được tàu chở hằng tuần đến Cảng Los Angeles/Long Beach, sau đó đi bằng đường sắt đến Texas.

segments.src: The importer has an annual service contract with one carrier, plus a forwarder to book extra space on the spot market during busy months.
segments.tr: Nhà nhập khẩu có hợp đồng dịch vụ hằng năm với một hãng tàu, cùng với một công ty giao nhận để đặt thêm chỗ trên thị trường giao ngay vào những tháng cao điểm.

segments.src: In 2021, demand surged during the pandemic and ports backed up.
segments.tr: Năm 2021, nhu cầu tăng vọt trong đại dịch và các cảng bị ùn tắc.

segments.src: Spot rates from China to the US West Coast, measured by indexes like the FBX, climbed above **$20,000 per 40-foot container**.
segments.tr: Cước giao ngay từ Trung Quốc đến bờ Tây nước Mỹ, đo bằng các chỉ số như FBX, đã vượt **20.000 USD cho mỗi container 40 feet**.

segments.src: Before the pandemic they had typically been under $2,000.
segments.tr: Trước đại dịch, mức này thường dưới 2.000 USD.

segments.src: Importers who relied on the spot market saw shipping costs jump, which pushed up retail prices.
segments.tr: Những nhà nhập khẩu phụ thuộc vào thị trường giao ngay chứng kiến chi phí vận chuyển tăng vọt, và điều này đẩy giá bán lẻ lên.

segments.src: Importers with contracts were better protected, though not always, because some carriers struggled to honor every contracted slot.
segments.tr: Những nhà nhập khẩu có hợp đồng được bảo vệ tốt hơn, dù không phải lúc nào cũng vậy, vì một số hãng tàu gặp khó khăn trong việc đáp ứng mọi suất đã ký kết.

segments.src: Meanwhile, a grain exporter in New Orleans shipping soybeans to Asia uses the **tramp** market.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, một nhà xuất khẩu ngũ cốc ở New Orleans vận chuyển đậu nành sang châu Á sử dụng thị trường **tramp**.

segments.src: It charters a whole bulk carrier, and it watches the **Baltic Dry Index** rather than container indexes.
segments.tr: Nhà xuất khẩu này thuê nguyên một tàu chở hàng rời, và theo dõi **Baltic Dry Index** thay vì các chỉ số container.

segments.src: Same ocean, different markets.
segments.tr: Cùng một đại dương, nhưng khác thị trường.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt trong 3 dòng

segments.tr: 1. Vận tải **liner** khai thác các tuyến cố định, theo lịch trình cho hàng container (xe buýt). Vận tải **tramp** được thuê theo nhu cầu cho hàng rời (taxi).

segments.src: 2. **Alliances** let container carriers share vessel space to offer wider networks, but unlike old conferences, they don't fix prices.
segments.tr: 2. **Liên minh** cho phép các hãng container chia sẻ không gian tàu để cung cấp mạng lưới rộng hơn, nhưng không giống các hiệp hội cũ, họ không ấn định giá.

segments.src: 3. **Freight indexes** like the BDI (bulk) and SCFI, WCI, and FBX (containers) track volatile shipping costs that directly affect product prices.
segments.tr: 3. **Các chỉ số cước vận tải** như BDI (hàng rời) và SCFI, WCI, FBX (container) theo dõi chi phí vận chuyển biến động, vốn ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến giá sản phẩm.

segments.src: - **Liner shipping**: Scheduled ocean service on fixed routes, mainly for containers, open to many shippers.

segments.src: - **Tramp shipping**: Unscheduled ocean service in which ships are chartered to carry cargo, usually bulk, wherever it's needed.

segments.src: - **Charter party**: The contract for hiring a ship (voyage, time, or bareboat).
segments.tr: - **Charter party**: Hợp đồng thuê tàu (theo chuyến, theo thời hạn hoặc thuê trần).

segments.src: - **Shipping alliance**: A group of container carriers that share vessel space and coordinate services without fixing prices.
segments.tr: - **Liên minh hãng tàu**: Nhóm các hãng container chia sẻ không gian tàu và phối hợp dịch vụ mà không ấn định giá.

segments.src: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: A standard 40-foot container, the usual unit for quoting container freight rates.
segments.tr: - **FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: Container 40 feet tiêu chuẩn, đơn vị thường dùng để báo cước vận chuyển container.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – C.
segments.tr: *Đáp án: Câu 1 – C.

segments.src: Renting a ship with its crew for a set period is a time charter.
segments.tr: Thuê tàu cùng thuyền viên trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định là thuê theo thời hạn (time charter).

segments.src: A voyage charter covers a single trip, and a bareboat charter excludes the crew.
segments.tr: Thuê theo chuyến chỉ áp dụng cho một hành trình, còn thuê trần không bao gồm thuyền viên.

segments.src: Q2 – False.
segments.tr: Câu 2 – Sai.

segments.src: Alliances share vessel space and schedules, but each carrier sets its own prices.
segments.tr: Các liên minh chia sẻ không gian tàu và lịch trình, nhưng mỗi hãng tự định giá.

segments.src: Joint price-fixing was the feature of the old liner conferences.
segments.tr: Việc cùng ấn định giá là đặc điểm của các hiệp hội liner cũ.

segments.src: Q3 – B.
segments.tr: Câu 3 – B.

segments.src: The Baltic Dry Index tracks dry bulk charter costs.
segments.tr: Baltic Dry Index theo dõi chi phí thuê tàu chở hàng rời khô.

segments.src: The other three track container rates.*
segments.tr: Ba chỉ số còn lại theo dõi cước container.*
